a1_stop_profile.convention: For each pure cell/env, cutoff is the last command-phase post-yaw. stop drift is wrapped(final hold post-yaw - cutoff post-yaw). Settle time is measured from cutoff through the end of the last hold sample with abs(yaw_velocity_rad_s)>0.05; if none, it is 0. Residual drift is wrapped(final hold post-yaw minus the post-yaw immediately after that last above-threshold sample, or cutoff yaw when no such sample exists).

a2_hold_stability.convention: For each pure cell/env, A2 is the maximum absolute wrapped yaw difference from final hold post-yaw over the last 1.0 s; the last-hold velocity is reported separately. For u=-2,T1/T2/T4, finite_transient is allowed only when every env last-hold abs velocity is <=0.05 rad/s; otherwise the classification is continuing_rate.

a3_xy_and_coupling.pure_hold_xy_convention: Hold XY is the vector sum of root_motion_xy_world over the zero-command hold; per-env norm and the per-cell worst norm are reported.

preregistered.name: waypoint_misses_concentrated_at_high_yaw_error
preregistered.pass_condition: point-biserial correlation >= 0.30 and median abs yaw error among waypoint misses exceeds hits by >= 0.05 rad

rule.condition_iii: max hold XY <= 0.03 m OR A3 concentration rule true
rule.go: at least one candidate passes all three conditions
rule.selection_positive_direction: positive means requested raw command u > 0; realized command-window yaw sign is reported separately and is not substituted for raw sign

a3_concentration_rule.pass_condition: point-biserial correlation >= 0.30 and median abs yaw error among waypoint misses exceeds hits by >= 0.05 rad
